root.label: Tennessee governor proposes renaming Nashville airport for Dolly Parton

events.label: Tennessee governor proposes renaming Nashville airport for Dolly Parton

slots.name: proposed new name for Nashville airport
date of proposal discussion
slots.sentence: The proposal will be discussed by the Metro Nashville Airport Authority at its next meeting on Sept. 17.

slots.name: date of Dolly Parton's death
slots.sentence: Lee said he wants to create a lasting tribute to the "indelible legacy" of the country music legend, who died on Tuesday at the age of 80.

slots.name: Nashville airport ranking by traffic
slots.sentence: The change would make Parton the first woman whose name adorns one of America’s 50 busiest airports .

slots.name: petition start date
slots.sentence: Long before 80-year-old Parton died Tuesday , fans in January 2025 started an online petition calling for officials to rename Nashville International Airport in her honor.

slots.name: number of signatures on petition
slots.sentence: It got renewed attention following Parton’s death, jumping to more than 155,000 signatures Friday.
